source: ProductCatalog.cs, written 2026-10-15; 2026-10-15 reglas de uso añadidas tras el banco de práctica (sin copiar sus frases); «arguments»: meanings of single arguments, put on their schema (2026-10-15, own path set 3/8 → 6/8)

tools.app.close: Close an open application gracefully, never force-killing it: by appId (as in app_open), all its windows; by windowId (from window_resolve or window_active, never invented; it expires after 5 minutes: invalid_or_expired_window_id), that one window. A window answering with its own dialog (saving) stops it: close_prompted. Use when: the person asks to close an app or its window. Do not use when: every window of the desktop (use window_close_all), force-killing a hung program (use system_process_terminate_named), a web page (use browser_control). Examples: «cierra el spotify», «cierra esta ventana» (window_active gives its windowId), «close chrome».
tools.app.installed: Check whether a normal application is installed on this PC, in the Windows Start catalog, without opening it; a name the catalog does not list comes back inStartCatalog false (programs outside Start are not seen), with the closest catalog names. Use when: the request is a question about an app being installed. Do not use when: the person wants it opened (use app_open), the target is a game (use game_installed_named), or asks if it is open right now (use window_application_status). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el zoom?», «¿está instalado discord?», «is obs installed?».
tools.app.open: Open an application or game launcher by name (Steam, Epic Games, Discord, Spotify, Notepad, Calculator) and verify its window appeared; the result says whether it is in front (foreground) and, if not, which window holds the front. Use when: abre/open/inicia an app or launcher. Do not use when: asking if installed (use app_installed or game_installed_named), playing a game (use game_launch), playing music or video (use media_play_query or streaming_play_named), an already open window (use window_focus), a file (use file_open). Examples: «abre steam», «ábreme el discord», «open spotify». Set foreground true so the person sees it, and forControl true; set forControl false only when the person asks to run it as administrator. place opens a section of the app directly, with no clicks: {app_places}. placeValue is what to search when the place is a search (the person's own words, a topic or a kind of game is enough, e.g. «terror»), and the game's name, as the person said it, for game. Look at the window afterwards to see where it arrived.
tools.app.restart: Restart an open app: its windows close gracefully as with app_close (never forced; a dialog of its own, such as saving, stops it: close_prompted), its processes must end within 10 s (app_kept_running if it stays running hidden; never killed), then app_open opens it again; only a new process counts (else app_restart_not_verified). appId as in app_open. Use when: reinicia or restart an app. Do not use when: the PC (use system_power). Examples: «reinicia la calculadora», «restart vlc», «reinícialo» right after an app was opened (that app).
tools.audio.app.volume.adjust: Raise or lower one application's volume (its mixer slider) by an amount from its current level; master volume untouched. Only applications playing on the default output are found. Use when: an app is named with sube/baja/más/menos and an amount. Do not use when: an exact target level (use audio_app_volume_set), no app named (use audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «bájale 20 al spotify», «sube el volumen de discord en 10», «turn down chrome by 15».
tools.audio.app.volume.set: Set one application's volume (its mixer slider) to an exact level 0-100, even while paused; master volume untouched. Only applications playing on the default output are found. Use when: an app is named with a target number or percent. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount (use audio_app_volume_adjust), no app named (use audio_volume). Examples: «pon el spotify al 30», «discord al 50 por ciento», «set chrome volume to 20».
tools.audio.microphone.mute: Mute or unmute the default microphone (sound input). Use when: the person mentions the micrófono or mic. Do not use when: muting the speakers or headphones (use audio_mute), the microphone inside Discord (use client_microphone_set). Examples: «silencia el micrófono», «activa el micro de nuevo», «mutea el mic».
tools.audio.mute: Mute or unmute the PC sound output (speakers or headphones). Use when: silencia, mutea or quita el silencio for the sound in general. Do not use when: the microphone (use audio_microphone_mute), pausing what plays (use media_control), changing the level (use audio_volume or audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «silencia el pc», «quítale el mute», «mute the sound». This is the operation for silencing the whole PC or computer: silencing never turns anything off.
tools.audio.status: Read which audio output is in use, its volume and whether it is muted, without changing anything. Use when: the person asks the current volume or where the sound comes out. Do not use when: changing the volume (use audio_volume or audio_volume_adjust), asking which song plays (use media_status). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el volumen?», «¿por dónde sale el sonido?», «¿está muteado el pc?».
tools.audio.volume: Set the PC master volume to an exact level 0-100. Use when: a target number or percent is given («al 50», «a 40», «en 30»), even with the verb sube/baja. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount from the current level (use audio_volume_adjust), one app only (use audio_app_volume_set), muting (use audio_mute). Examples: «pon el volumen al 50», «volumen en 20», «sube el volumen al 80».
tools.audio.volume.adjust: Raise or lower the PC master volume by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube/baja/más/menos with an amount and no target level. Do not use when: a target level is given with «al N», «a N» or «en N» (use audio_volume), one app only (use audio_app_volume_adjust). Examples: «sube el volumen 10», «bájale 20 al volumen», «turn it down by 5».
tools.backup.create: Make a private backup copy of one file of BAXY's work folder already identified (resource id and hash, as filesystem_list gives them); the person's own folders are backed up whole with backup_known_create. Its SHA-256 is checked against the original and recorded. Use when: backing up a single file found earlier. Do not use when: a whole known folder (use backup_known_create), zipping (use file_compress). Examples: «haz un respaldo de ese archivo», «sácale una copia de seguridad a ese informe de la carpeta de trabajo», «backup ese archivo».
tools.backup.known.create: Create a ZIP backup of a known folder (desktop, documents, pictures or projects; all_known is desktop, documents and pictures, not projects) with its manifest; the written ZIP's hash is read back, its entries are not compared with the folder again. Not in it: reparse points (OneDrive placeholders, links), files it cannot open (held by another program, without permission, or gone meanwhile), folders it cannot open and anything past 32 levels; skippedReparsePointFiles, skippedReparsePointFolders and skippedUnreadableFiles count the first three (the rest is uncounted). With nothing copied it fails: known_backup_nothing_readable (files found that could not be copied) or known_backup_nothing_copied (none found where it could look), never saying the folder is empty. Use when: respaldar or backup of a whole folder. Do not use when: backing up one single file (use backup_create), just zipping a file or folder next to itself (use file_compress). Examples: «haz un backup de documentos», «respalda el escritorio», «backup de mis fotos».
tools.backup.known.list: List the ZIP backups of known folders and re-verify that they are intact (20 by default). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: asking which folder backups exist. Do not use when: backups of single files (use backup_list). Examples: «¿qué respaldos de carpetas tengo?», «muéstrame los backups de documentos», «lista mis copias de seguridad de carpetas».
tools.backup.known.restore.latest: Restore the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder by extracting it into a new separate folder; the original is not overwritten. Use when: recuperar or restaurar a folder backup. Do not use when: only checking integrity (use backup_known_verify_latest), a single-file backup (use backup_restore). Examples: «restaura el último backup de documentos», «recupera el respaldo del escritorio», «restore my pictures backup».
tools.backup.known.verify.latest: Check that the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder is intact (SHA-256), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether a folder backup is OK. Do not use when: restoring it (use backup_known_restore_latest), a single-file backup (use backup_verify). Examples: «verifica el último respaldo de documentos», «¿está bien el backup del escritorio?», «chequea el backup de fotos».
tools.backup.list: List the private backups of single files, newest first, each saying whether it still has the SHA-256 recorded when it was made. 20 by default (totalCount says how many there are). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: asking about backups of individual files. Do not use when: ZIP backups of whole folders (use backup_known_list). Examples: «¿qué archivos tengo respaldados?», «lista los respaldos de archivos», «muéstrame las copias de archivos sueltos».
tools.backup.restore: Restore a single-file backup into a free path of BAXY's private work folder (sandbox); a backup changed since it was made, or without its recorded SHA-256, is not restored. Use when: recovering a file backup listed earlier. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup_known_restore_latest). Examples: «restaura ese respaldo», «recupera la copia del informe», «restore that backup».
tools.backup.verify: Check that a private single-file backup is intact (its SHA-256 against the one recorded when it was made), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether one file backup is OK. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup_known_verify_latest), restoring it (use backup_restore). Examples: «verifica ese respaldo», «¿está intacta la copia del informe?», «check that backup».
tools.bluetooth.device.list: List the Bluetooth devices Windows knows, connecting none: the paired ones (paired true), on or in range now or not, and unpaired ones it found (canPair: whether they can be paired). It does not tell which are near or connected. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: asking which Bluetooth devices there are. Do not use when: pairing one (use bluetooth_device_pair), asking whether Bluetooth is on (use bluetooth_radio_status), wired peripherals (use peripheral_list). Examples: «¿qué dispositivos bluetooth hay?», «busca audífonos bluetooth», «lista los bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.device.pair: Pair an already identified Bluetooth device through Windows' own pairing dialog and permission. Pairing is not connecting: a device already paired comes back paired true without being connected, and BAXY has no tool that connects one. Use when: emparejar or vincular a Bluetooth device. Do not use when: only listing devices (use bluetooth_device_list), turning Bluetooth on (use bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «empareja mis audífonos», «vincula el parlante bluetooth», «pair the jbl».
tools.bluetooth.radio.set: Turn the PC's Bluetooth radio on or off. Use when: prende/apaga/activa/desactiva el bluetooth. Do not use when: only asking its state (use bluetooth_radio_status), Wi-Fi (use wifi_radio_set), airplane mode for all radios (use system_settings_set). Examples: «prende el bluetooth», «apaga el bluetooth», «turn on bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.radio.status: Read whether Bluetooth is on or off, without changing it. Use when: asking about the Bluetooth state. Do not use when: switching it (use bluetooth_radio_set), listing devices (use bluetooth_device_list). Examples: «¿está prendido el bluetooth?», «¿tengo el bluetooth activado?», «¿el bluetooth está on?».
tools.browser.control: Act on the active tab of the person's own default browser (its front window): back, reload, scroll up or down, new tab, fullscreen video or leave it (exit_fullscreen), close the page or all pages but the last (closing the last would close the window: with one tab nothing is closed and the result says so). close_all stops after 50 tabs or 40 seconds (user_browser_close_all_incomplete; closedTabs says how many). Use when: the person refers to the current page. Do not use when: a new address (use browser_navigate), scrolling a non-browser window (use input_pointer_control), closing another app (use app_close). Examples: «vuelve atrás», «baja en la página», «recarga la página», «sal de pantalla completa».
tools.browser.navigate: Go to an exact web address in the person's browser; also open a search-results page there when the engine or browser is named as the place («búscalo en Google»). Use when: a URL or site is given. Do not use when: a browser is named (use browser_navigate_named), an answer is wanted (use web_search), a YouTube video should play (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «abre youtube.com», «ve a wikipedia.org», «búscalo en google». Never use it to reach a section of a desktop application that is open on screen (a library, a tab, a settings page): that is app_open with place when the section is one of its places, otherwise input_visible_click on its label.
tools.browser.navigate.named: Open a web address in a named browser: Opera, Opera GX, Chrome, Edge or Brave. Use when: the person names one of those browsers as where the page opens. Do not use when: no browser is named (use browser_navigate), only the browser app is wanted with no page (use app_open). Examples: «abre youtube en opera gx», «abre gmail en chrome», «open netflix.com en edge».
tools.browser.page.read: Read the title, address and visible text of the page in front in the person's own default browser (or in BAXY's own browser while a session of it is open), without touching it: up to 6,000 characters (maximumCharacters can ask for fewer; truncated says when it was cut). Use when: asking what the current page says or to summarize it. Do not use when: a PDF or text file (use file_read), searching the internet (use web_search), listing tabs (use browser_tabs_list). Examples: «¿qué dice esta página?», «resúmeme la página», «lee la web abierta».
tools.browser.tabs.list: List the tabs of the person's own default browser (its front window), with their titles and, when the browser says it, which one is active (20 by default). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: asking which tabs or pestañas are open. Do not use when: reading one page's text (use browser_page_read), asking which app window is in front (use window_active). Examples: «¿qué pestañas tengo abiertas?», «lista las pestañas», «muéstrame los tabs».
tools.calculator.expression.evaluate: Type a simple arithmetic expression into the open Windows Calculator and read the result it displays. Use when: the person asks to compute something in the Calculator. Do not use when: the Calculator should only be opened (use app_open). Examples: «calcula 25 por 4 en la calculadora», «usa la calculadora para 120 entre 3», «súmalo en la calculadora: 15 más 27». Only when the person explicitly asks to use the Calculator app; a plain arithmetic question is answered directly in text, without tools. expression: numbers with + - * / only, no parentheses; in its Standard mode the Calculator applies each operator in the order typed, so «(12+8)*3» is written «12+8*3» (it shows 60). It must be open and not minimized first (app_open), in Standard mode: in any other mode nothing is pressed, and the result says calculator_mode_not_standard (Scientific, Programmer) or calculator_button_not_found (a converter, date calculation). It clears the display first (what the person had there is lost).
tools.calendar.event.create: Create an event with a title, start time and end time in the person's Outlook calendar (Outlook syncs it to their account when the account syncs; the result reads it back on this PC); BAXY asks the person first. Use when: agendar a meeting or appointment with a time span. Do not use when: something must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), a to-do (use task_create). Examples: «agenda una reunión mañana de 3 a 4», «crea un evento el viernes de 10 a 11», «dentista en el calendario el lunes de 9 a 10».
tools.calendar.event.list: List the events of Outlook's default calendar between two dates or times at most 366 days apart (longer is refused, calendar_range_invalid), changing nothing (other accounts and calendars are not read): at most 200 are read (truncatedAt200 past them), and a view shows the first 20 (eventsShown; the rest is not reached). Use when: asking what is on the calendar or agenda: meetings today, the next meeting. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule_alarms), tasks (use task_list). Examples: «¿qué tengo en el calendario mañana?», «muéstrame mis eventos de esta semana», «¿tengo reuniones hoy?».
tools.capture.active.window: Take a screenshot of only the active window; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder (pictures puts it into its Screenshots folder). Use when: the capture is of this window or the current app. Do not use when: the whole desktop (use capture_screenshot), reading or describing the screen (use ocr_read or vision_describe after a capture). Examples: «captura la ventana activa», «sácale foto a esta ventana», «screenshot de esta ventana».
tools.capture.screenshot: Take a screenshot of the whole desktop; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, or pictures, where it goes into its Screenshots folder). Use when: captura de pantalla, pantallazo or screenshot without limiting it to one window. Do not use when: only the active window (use capture_active_window). Examples: «toma una captura de pantalla», «saca un pantallazo y guárdalo en el escritorio», «haz un screenshot».
tools.client.channel.locate: Search Discord's quick switcher for a channel or chat by name and say whether a row with exactly that name appears (found compares the row's name before its first comma; a direct chat's row carries the account after the name, so for a chat read switcherRows, the rows as shown), joining or opening nothing. The switcher is closed only while Discord stays in front with the focus in it; on success, a switcher it did not close (switcherNotClosed) or Discord left shown is said; a failure after the shortcut only says an effect may have occurred (switcher or Discord may be left open); with no rows read the result is not_read, never «no such channel». Use when: whether a Discord channel or chat exists. Do not use when: writing a message (use message_draft), opening Discord (use app_open). Examples: «busca el canal general en discord», «¿está el canal de música en discord?», «find the memes channel en discord».
tools.client.microphone.set: Mute or unmute the person's own microphone inside Discord, by Discord's own mute button, and read it back; muted true silences it, false turns it back on. Use when: the person names Discord with the micrófono or mic (mutear, silenciar, desmutear, activar). Do not use when: the PC's microphone with no app named (use audio_microphone_mute), speakers or headphones (use audio_mute). Examples: «mutéame en discord», «quita el silencio de mi micro en discord».
tools.clipboard.copy: Copy what is selected in the active window, like Ctrl+C. Use when: copia esto or copy the selection. Do not use when: putting a given text in the clipboard (use clipboard_write_text), reading what was copied (use clipboard_read_text), selecting first (use input_select_all). Examples: «copia lo seleccionado», «cópialo», «copy this».
tools.clipboard.paste: Paste the clipboard contents where the cursor is, like Ctrl+V. Use when: pega or paste. Do not use when: typing a given text (use input_text_type), reading the clipboard aloud (use clipboard_read_text), pasting into an app the person names (use clipboard_paste_into). Examples: «pega aquí», «pégalo», «paste it».
tools.clipboard.paste.into: Paste what the person copied into an application they name: a new document of it is opened (a new note, a new text, a new sheet) and the paste goes there. appId is the application, as for app_open. Use when: pega or pon lo copiado en an app the person names, new or not. Do not use when: pasting where the cursor already is, no app named (use clipboard_paste). Examples: «pégalo en un Word nuevo», «abre una nota nueva y pon ahí lo que copié».
tools.clipboard.read.text: Read the text currently in the clipboard, without changing it. It returns up to 6,000 characters (maxCharacters can ask for fewer); truncated and characterCount say when it was cut. Use when: asking what was copied. Do not use when: pasting it somewhere (use clipboard_paste), copying the selection (use clipboard_copy). Examples: «¿qué tengo copiado?», «lee el portapapeles», «what's in my clipboard?».
tools.clipboard.write.text: Put a given text into the clipboard for later pasting, without copying anything from the screen. Use when: the person dictates the text to place in the clipboard. Do not use when: copying the on-screen selection (use clipboard_copy), typing the text directly (use input_text_type). Examples: «copia al portapapeles hola mundo», «pon en el portapapeles 'nos vemos a las 8'», «guarda 'listo' en el clipboard».
tools.desktop.wallpaper.set: Change the desktop wallpaper to a solid color, written as #RRGGBB (azul #004E98, negro #000000), or to an image from a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, pictures). Only an image directly in the folder (file_name_invalid otherwise). Use when: cambia el fondo de pantalla or wallpaper. Do not use when: brightness (use system_settings_set). Examples: «cambia el fondo de pantalla a azul», «pon de fondo playa.jpg de imágenes», «cambia el wallpaper a negro».
tools.display.mode.set: Set the main monitor's refresh rate, resolution or both, only to a mode its driver lists (else display_mode_not_listed, nothing changed); read back, and put back when it differs. A resolution alone keeps the refresh rate if listed, else the highest. Use when: cambia los Hz o la resolución. Do not use when: brightness (use system_settings_adjust), reading the mode (use display_status). Examples: «pon el monitor a 75 hz», «resolución a 1280x720».
tools.display.status: Read which monitors are connected and their resolution and refresh rate, without changing anything. Use when: asking about monitors, resolution or Hz. Do not use when: brightness (use system_settings_status), general PC specs (use system_status). Examples: «¿cuántos monitores tengo?», «¿qué resolución tiene la pantalla?», «¿a cuántos hz está el monitor?».
tools.document.presentation.create: Create a PowerPoint (.pptx) with a title and 1 to 12 slides (first line the slide's title, the next 8 lines bullets; more lines are left out, bulletLinesLeftOut counts them) in a known folder; more than 12 slides is refused (invalid arguments). Use when: hazme un powerpoint or una presentación. Do not use when: Word or Excel (use office_document_create), a plain text file (use file_write). Examples: «haz un powerpoint de 5 diapositivas sobre el reciclaje», «crea una presentación sobre Chile», «make a ppt de marketing».
tools.email.latest.read: Read the most recent email received in Outlook. Only the newest 100 items of the default Inbox are looked at; a body over 6,000 characters is cut (bodyTruncated, bodyLength). Use when: asking for the last or newest email. Do not use when: replying to it (use email_latest_reply), writing a new email (use email_send). Examples: «lee mi último correo», «¿qué dice el último mail?», «read my latest email».
tools.email.latest.reply: Reply with a given text to the most recent email received in Outlook. Only the newest 100 items of the default Inbox are looked at. The result carries the answered email's body, cut at 6,000 characters (bodyTruncated, bodyLength). Use when: respóndele or contéstale al último correo. Do not use when: a new email to an address (use email_send), only reading it (use email_latest_read). Examples: «responde al último correo que llego tarde», «contéstale al último mail: gracias», «reply ok al último email».
tools.email.send: Send a new email to an address, with an optional subject, from the owner's Outlook. Without a subject, the first line is used (a first line over 78 characters is cut to 75 and «…»). Use when: a correo or mail to a given address with its text. Do not use when: replying to the last email (use email_latest_reply), WhatsApp or Discord (use message_draft), a test send (use message_send_test). Examples: «manda un correo a juan@gmail.com que mañana no voy», «envía un mail a ana@empresa.cl con asunto reunión», «send an email a pedro@mail.com: listo».
tools.file.compress: Compress a file or folder from a known folder into a ZIP with the same name next to it. Only an item directly in the folder (file_name_invalid otherwise). Use when: comprimir or zipear. Do not use when: a verified backup of a whole known folder (use backup_known_create). Examples: «comprime la carpeta fotos del escritorio», «haz un zip de informe.docx en documentos», «zipea proyecto en descargas».
tools.file.edit: Replace an exact piece of text with another in a text file of up to 4 MiB in a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder), by name or the relativePath file_find gave; the previous version goes to the Recycle Bin. oldText must appear exactly once unless replaceAll is true: copy it exactly as file_read showed it. A name found no time or several times returns at most 5 candidates (candidatesTruncated), looked for 12 levels deep. Use when: cambia X por Y en un archivo, corrige una línea or a word inside a file. Do not use when: writing the whole content (use file_write), adding at the end (use file_write with append), a note (use note_update). Examples: «en notas.txt cambia lunes por martes», «corrige 'hloa' por 'hola' en el readme.md», «reemplaza todas las veces 2024 por 2025 en informe.md». A file inside a subfolder: the subfolder goes in subdirectory, or give fileName as the full path the person said.
tools.file.find: List the top level of a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder, or all), or find files under it by name (part of it, or a pattern like *.pdf) or by a text inside its text files (20 results by default; a top-level listing shows 50 by default, without hidden and system entries); order recent puts the newest first, order size the largest first (a search by content stops at limit hits and orders only those, so the newest overall may not be among them); each file comes with relativePath and size in bytes. A search goes 12 folders deep (in the home folder, without hidden or system folders) and a text search reads at most 2,000 files of any kind (only text files of up to 1 MiB for the text); searchScope says what was covered (exhaustive false, the files skipped). timeLimitReached: what it found so far, not all. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: qué hay en a folder, busca el archivo X, dónde está mi X, which file mentions X. Do not use when: BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem_list or filesystem_search), reading a file (use file_read), notes (use note_search), the internet (use web_search). Examples: «¿qué hay en el escritorio?», «busca el archivo presupuesto», «¿qué archivo de documentos habla de la reunión con Juan?». A subfolder of the folder goes in subdirectory («Viajes», or the full path the person said when it lies inside the folder).
tools.file.open: Open a specific file by its name from a known folder with its default app or a named installed app. name may carry subfolders («proyecto\informe.docx»). A file not there is not opened: seenElsewhere says in which known folder and subfolders a file of that exact name was seen, so you can open it from there; seenElsewhere looks 4 levels deep in desktop, documents, downloads and pictures, 5 places at most within 3 seconds (searchComplete false: it may be elsewhere too). Only documents, images, audio, video and .zip or .7z files open (file_extension_not_openable). Use when: abre el archivo X. Do not use when: the newest unnamed file (use filesystem_file_open_latest), a folder (use filesystem_folder_open), an application (use app_open), reading without showing (use file_read). Examples: «abre tarea.docx del escritorio», «abre foto.png de descargas con paint», «open informe.pdf», «abre notas.txt de mi carpeta Proyectos» → folder home, name «Proyectos\notas.txt». Set foreground true so the person sees the file.
tools.file.read: Read the text of a file by its name (or the relativePath file_find gave) from a known folder: a text or code file (txt, md, json, code) or a PDF (its own text, no OCR), without opening it on screen. A text file over 4 MiB (known_text_too_large) or a PDF over 64 MiB (known_pdf_too_large) is not read. A long file comes in pages: when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset. totalLines (the whole file) and lines (the returned text) are already counted: say those numbers, never count yourself. A name found no time or several times returns at most 5 candidates (candidatesTruncated), looked for 12 levels deep (in the home folder, without hidden or system folders). PDF text extraction stops at 90 seconds (pdf_text_extraction_timeout). Use when: qué dice, resume or lee a named file. Do not use when: showing it on screen (use file_open), a file in BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem_read_text), the open web page (use browser_page_read), a Word or Excel document BAXY created (use office_document_read). Examples: «resume el pdf contrato.pdf», «¿de qué trata el roadmap.md?», «léeme notas.txt del escritorio». A file inside a subfolder: the subfolder goes in subdirectory, or give fileName as the full path the person said when it lies inside the folder.
tools.file.write: Write text to a file in Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder or BAXY's work folder: create it, replace one (pass expectedSha256, the fileSha256 file_read gave; the previous version goes to the Recycle Bin), or with append true add the text as a new line at the end. relativePath is the path inside the folder, subfolders included («proyectos/notas.txt»); the full path the person said («C:\Users\ana\proyectos\notas.txt», with folder home) is accepted when it lies inside the folder. append refuses a file over 10 MiB (file_too_large). Use when: crea un archivo de texto, escribe X en un archivo, agrega una línea al final de un archivo. Do not use when: changing only part of a file (use file_edit), a note (use note_create), Word or Excel (use office_document_create), a PowerPoint (use document_presentation_create). Examples: «crea hola.txt en el escritorio que diga hola», «agrega 'comprar pan' al final de lista.txt», «save this en notas.txt».
tools.filesystem.copy: Copy an already identified file to another path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash. Use when: copying a sandbox file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a backup (use backup_create), files in Desktop, Documents or Downloads (sandbox only). Examples: «copia ese archivo a la carpeta respaldo», «duplica notas.txt en tu carpeta de trabajo», «copy it to otra carpeta».
tools.filesystem.create.directory: Create a new folder in Desktop, Documents, Downloads, the user's home folder or BAXY's private work folder; relativePath may include subfolders («proyectos/src»), or be the full path the person said when it lies inside the folder. Use when: crea una carpeta. Do not use when: opening an existing folder (use filesystem_folder_open), creating a file (use file_write). Examples: «crea una carpeta proyectos en el escritorio», «haz una carpeta nueva llamada fotos en documentos», «make a folder tareas en descargas».
tools.filesystem.explorer.count: Count the files with an extension directly in a folder: the known folder named (folder: desktop, documents, downloads, home, pictures) or a folder inside it (subdirectory), or without folder the one of the File Explorer window in front (no_explorer_in_front: none in front; explorer_front_not_read or explorer_front_tab_not_known: its folder could not be told; explorer_in_front_shows_no_file_folder: it shows no file folder; then ask which folder). Hidden and system files are not counted. Use when: cuántos archivos .X hay. Do not use when: listing or searching files (use file_find). Examples: «¿cuántos archivos .py hay en esta carpeta?», «cuenta los pdf del escritorio», «how many jpg hay aquí?».
tools.filesystem.file.open.latest: Open the most recently modified document, image, audio, video or .zip/.7z file of a known folder, without the person naming it; programs, installers, disk images and other kinds are skipped, so a newer one of those is not opened. Only files directly in the folder (not its subfolders), hidden and system ones skipped. Use when: lo último que descargué or el archivo más reciente. Do not use when: the file is named (use file_open), opening the folder itself (use filesystem_folder_open). Examples: «abre el último archivo de descargas», «abre lo último que bajé», «open the newest file en documentos».
tools.filesystem.folder.open: Open a known Windows folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, the user's home folder), or a folder inside it (subdirectory), in File Explorer. Use when: abre la carpeta de descargas or documentos. Do not use when: saying its contents aloud (use file_find), opening a file (use file_open), creating a folder (use filesystem_create_directory). Examples: «abre descargas», «ábreme la carpeta documentos», «open my pictures folder».
tools.filesystem.known.duplicates: Find duplicate files in Downloads (same size and SHA-256), deleting or changing nothing. 20 groups by default; at most 10,000 files are hashed (candidatesCapped), 12 levels deep. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: archivos repetidos or duplicados. Do not use when: deleting a file (use filesystem_known_trash_named), comparing two text files line by line (use filesystem_sandbox_diff_named). Examples: «busca archivos duplicados en descargas», «¿tengo archivos repetidos?», «find duplicates en downloads».
tools.filesystem.known.trash.named: Delete a file, or a folder with everything in it (isFolder and entries say so), by its name from a known folder (or a subdirectory of it; the user's home folder too) by sending it to the Windows Recycle Bin, where the person can restore it. A name found several times returns at most 5 candidates (candidatesTruncated), looked for 12 levels deep. Use when: borra or elimina the file X. Do not use when: emptying the Windows Recycle Bin (use system_recyclebin_empty), a note or task (use note_trash or task_delete), an alarm or reminder (use schedule_alarms). Examples: «borra viejo.txt del escritorio», «elimina foto1.png de descargas», «delete tarea.docx».
tools.filesystem.list: List what is in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), never the person's folders (their home folder and everything under it are file_find). 50 by default (totalCount, hasMore); the ids it gives last 5 minutes. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: the person refers to BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents, Downloads or any folder the person names, even one whose name contains BAXY: it is theirs (use file_find). Examples: «¿qué hay en tu carpeta de trabajo?», «lista tus archivos de trabajo», «muéstrame el sandbox».
tools.filesystem.move: Move an already identified file to a new path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash: the destination is the file's whole new path, folder and name («viejos/notas.txt»), never a folder alone. Use when: moving a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: the file is only known by its name (use filesystem_sandbox_move_named). Examples: «mueve ese archivo a la carpeta viejos», «pásalo a la subcarpeta 2025», «move it to archivo».
tools.filesystem.read.text: Read the text of an already identified file in BAXY's private work folder. Use when: reading a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a text file or PDF in the user's known folders (use file_read). Examples: «lee ese archivo», «¿qué dice ese txt de tu carpeta?», «read that file».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.diff.named: Compare two text files in BAXY's private work folder, each by its exact file name, and say which lines differ. Files up to 2 MiB each (sandbox_diff_file_too_large); a view shows 20 changed line numbers (changedLinesShown; changedLineCount is the total, past 100 changedLinesTruncated); lines are compared by position. Use when: compara a con b or en qué se diferencian. Do not use when: finding duplicate files (use filesystem_known_duplicates). Examples: «compara version1.txt con version2.txt», «¿qué cambia entre notas.txt y notas_viejas.txt?», «diff de config.json y config2.json».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.move.named: Move a file, given by its exact file name, to a new path inside BAXY's private work folder: the destination is the file's whole new path, folder and name («archivo/informe.txt»), never a folder alone. Use when: moving a work-folder file the person names. Do not use when: the file was already identified by id (use filesystem_move). Examples: «mueve informe.txt a la carpeta archivo», «pasa notas.txt a viejos», «move log.txt to backup».
tools.filesystem.search: Search files by name in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), not the user's folders. 50 by default (totalCount); links and placeholders are skipped. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: searching BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents or Downloads (use file_find). Examples: «busca informe en tu carpeta de trabajo», «¿tienes algún archivo log en tu carpeta?», «search notas en tu workspace».
tools.game.catalog.list: List the Steam games installed or downloading on this PC (their local manifests, not the whole library), optionally filtered by text (50 by default; a view shows 20 and totalCount says how many there are). Use when: qué juegos tengo. Do not use when: one game's ownership or install state (use game_entitlement_named or game_installed_named), playing (use game_launch), searching games to find or buy (the store's search: app_open Steam with place results). Examples: «¿qué juegos tengo en steam?», «lista mis juegos», «¿qué juegos tengo instalados en steam?».
tools.game.entitlement.named: Check whether a Steam or Epic game is in the person's library, per the store's local cache (it can miss an owned game), and whether it is installed, without downloading or opening anything. With Steam only a title matching exactly one game (case and accents aside) is resolved, otherwise the state is title_not_resolved; with Epic the first cache entry with that title is taken, and a game not found says not_in_local_library_cache (library_cache_unavailable: the cache could not be read; epic_launcher_data_not_found: Epic's data is not on this PC). Use when: do I own it or is it in my library. Do not use when: only installed-on-disk (use game_installed_named), downloading or installing, even asked as «¿puedes instalar…?» (use game_install_named), playing (use game_launch), opening Steam itself (use app_open). Examples: «¿tengo el hollow knight en steam?», «¿está fall guys en mi biblioteca de epic?», «do I own portal 2?».
tools.game.install.cancel: Cancel the partial download of one specific Steam game. Use when: cancela or para la descarga of a named game. Do not use when: canceling every download (use game_install_cancel_active), uninstalling (use game_uninstall_named). Examples: «cancela la descarga de dota», «para de bajar el cs2», «stop downloading terraria».
tools.game.install.cancel.active: Cancel the downloads Steam has started of games not installed yet; an update of an installed game or a queued install with nothing downloaded is not cancelled, and while one is there the result is steam_downloads_not_covered. Use when: cancel downloads with no game named, or all of them. Do not use when: one specific game is named (use game_install_cancel). Examples: «cancela todas las descargas de steam», «para las descargas», «stop all steam downloads».
tools.game.install.named: Download and install a Steam or Epic game by its title. Call it directly, never game_installed_named or game_entitlement_named first: Steam installs only a game the account owns, Epic only one its local entitlement cache shows owned. With Steam only a title matching exactly one game (case and accents aside) is resolved, otherwise steam_title_not_resolved; with Epic the first cache entry with that title is taken (else epic_entitlement_not_verified or epic_install_link_not_resolved; epic_launcher_data_not_found when Epic's library cache is not on this PC or could not be read). Use when: descarga or instala a game. Do not use when: searching or browsing a store (use app_open with place results), only asking whether it is installed or owned (use game_installed_named or game_entitlement_named), checking progress (use game_install_status), a normal program that is not a game (use package_install). Examples: «descarga el hollow knight», «instala fall guys en epic», «install terraria de steam».
tools.game.install.status: Check how the download or installation of an already identified Steam game is going. Use when: cómo va or cuánto le falta a una descarga. Do not use when: asking whether it is installed (use game_installed_named), starting a download (use game_install_named). Examples: «¿cómo va la descarga de dota?», «¿cuánto le falta al cs2?», «install progress de terraria». Only while a download or install is in progress; whether a game is installed or downloaded at all is game_installed_named.
tools.game.installed.named: Answer only whether a Steam or Epic game is installed on this PC, by its exact name in their manifests, without opening it (a game under another name or from another store is not seen). Use when: the request is a question («¿está instalado X?»). Do not use when: abre/juega/lanza (use game_launch for a game; «abre steam» is app_open), library ownership (use game_entitlement_named), normal apps (use app_installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el minecraft?», «¿está instalado el gta v?», «is rocket league installed?». Only for yes/no questions about installation; a request to play or open the game is game_launch.
tools.game.store.page: Open a game's page in the Steam store, by the game's title, and say which game it is. Use when: the page, the store page or the ficha of a game the person names. Do not use when: playing it (use game_launch), installing it (use game_install_named), whether it is owned or installed (use game_entitlement_named or game_installed_named). Examples: «quiero ver la ficha de Celeste en steam», «abre la página de Stardew Valley en la tienda». Look at the window afterwards to see it arrived.
tools.game.store.search: Search the Steam store with words (a title, a topic or a kind of game) and show its results. Use when: busca juegos or a game in Steam or its store. Do not use when: what is installed on this PC (use game_catalog_list), one known game's page (use game_store_page). Examples: «búscame algo de zombis en steam», «mira qué hay de estrategia en la tienda». Look at the window afterwards to see the results.
tools.game.launch: Launch (play) a Steam game installed on this PC. Use when: juega, abre or lanza a specific game title. Do not use when: opening Steam, Epic or any normal application (use app_open), only asking whether it is installed (use game_installed_named). Examples: «abre el hollow knight», «quiero jugar terraria», «lanza el cs2». appId must be the appId of one game in the installed games list below; never invent an id. If the person said it misheard or spelled differently and one title in the list is clearly that game, use it; if no title in the list is that game, do not launch: say it is not installed. Do not check whether it is installed first. title: the game the person asked for (game_title_mismatch: that appId is another game; its installedGames say which ones are here). A wish to play a game the person names is a launch, not an installed-check.
tools.game.uninstall.named: Uninstall an installed Steam game by its title, after confirmation. Only a title matching exactly one game (case and accents aside) is resolved; otherwise no_steam_manifest_with_that_name (an Epic game: epic_uninstall_not_supported). Use when: desinstala a game. Do not use when: a normal program (use package_uninstall), canceling a download (use game_install_cancel). Examples: «desinstala worms rumble», «borra el dota de steam», «uninstall terraria».
tools.input.key.press: Press one key or shortcut in the active window (Enter, Escape, Tab, arrows, Ctrl+S/Z/F/T/W, Alt+Tab, F5, Ctrl+Shift+Esc). Ctrl+W can close the whole window, so BAXY asks the person first. Use when: a key or shortcut is named. Do not use when: typing text (use input_text_type), select all (use input_select_all), copy or paste (use clipboard_copy or clipboard_paste), clicking a button (use input_visible_click). Examples: «presiona enter», «aprieta escape», «dale ctrl z». Pass window = the window number from your look at that window, so it acts there and not in the window the person has in front: if it is not in front, BAXY waits for the person's pause and brings it to the front for the act (nothing is sent if Windows does not give it); the front goes back after a text, and after a click or a key at the person's next input; a window the act itself brings up (a new window, another application's) keeps the front; a dialog of that same window (Guardar como) goes back with it.
tools.input.keyboard.layout: Switch the keyboard input language of the active window to Spanish. Use when: pon el teclado en español. Do not use when: only asking which language it is (use input_keyboard_status), the on-screen keyboard (use input_keyboard_open). Examples: «cambia el teclado a español», «pon el teclado en español», «teclado in spanish please».
tools.input.keyboard.open: Open the Windows on-screen keyboard. Use when: teclado en pantalla or teclado virtual. Do not use when: changing the keyboard language (use input_keyboard_layout), typing text (use input_text_type). Examples: «abre el teclado en pantalla», «muéstrame el teclado virtual», «open on-screen keyboard».
tools.input.keyboard.status: Read the input language of the active window's keyboard, without changing it. Use when: en qué idioma está el teclado. Do not use when: changing it (use input_keyboard_layout). Examples: «¿en qué idioma está el teclado?», «¿el teclado está en inglés?», «keyboard layout actual?».
tools.input.pointer.control: Move the mouse pointer to the screen center, click where it is, or scroll down. Use when: a raw mouse action with no target named. Do not use when: clicking a named button or option (use input_visible_click), scrolling a web page (use browser_control). Examples: «haz clic», «mueve el mouse al centro», «scrollea hacia abajo».
tools.input.scroll: Scroll the active window or a named list or panel up or down by an amount. Use when: baja, sube or desplázate in a page, list or document on screen. Do not use when: moving the mouse pointer (use input_pointer_control), clicking a visible option (use input_visible_click). Examples: «baja un poco la página», «sube en la lista», «scroll down». Pass window = the window number from your look at that window, so it acts there and not in the window the person has in front: if it is not in front, BAXY waits for the person's pause and brings it to the front for the act (nothing is sent if Windows does not give it); the front goes back at the person's next input; a window the act itself brings up (a new window, another application's) keeps the front; a dialog of that same window (Guardar como) goes back with it.
tools.input.select.all: Select everything in the focused control of the active window, like Ctrl+A. Use when: selecciona todo. Do not use when: copying (use clipboard_copy; select and copy are separate steps). Examples: «selecciona todo», «marca todo el texto», «select all».
tools.input.text.type: Type a given literal text where the cursor is, in the active window. The text carries no line break or tab: press Enter or Tab with input_key_press. input_text_not_read_back: the keys went in but what the window shows was not read back (a Word document is not): say it was typed without seeing it there. Use when: escribe or tipea a stated text. Do not use when: pasting the clipboard (use clipboard_paste), a chat message to someone (use message_draft), writing a file (use file_write), pressing a key (use input_key_press). Examples: «escribe hola mundo», «tipea buenos días». Pass window = the window number from your look at that window, so it acts there and not in the window the person has in front: if it is not in front, BAXY waits for the person's pause and brings it to the front for the act (nothing is sent if Windows does not give it); the front goes back after a text, and after a click or a key at the person's next input; a window the act itself brings up (a new window, another application's) keeps the front; a dialog of that same window (Guardar como) goes back with it.
tools.input.visible.click: Click a control or a text you saw in your last look at the window (input_visible_controls), by its label, adding its index when the look gave one. Use when: going to a section, tab or menu of an open app, or pressing a button there. Do not use when: the section is an app_open place (Windows Settings pages, Steam library or store, Discord directs: use app_open with place), you have not looked at the window yet (look first), a raw click where the pointer is (use input_pointer_control), going to a web address (use browser_navigate). Examples: «haz clic en aceptar», «pulsa guardar», «entra a Tu biblioteca» (after looking at Spotify). Pass window = the window number from your look, so it acts there: if it is not in front, BAXY waits for the person's pause and brings it forward (nothing is sent if Windows does not give it); the front goes back after a text, and after a click or key at the person's next input; a window the act brings up (a new window, another application's) keeps the front; a dialog of that window (Guardar como) goes back with it. Without window: with index, in the window of your last look; otherwise in the application you just opened, else in the window the person has in front. It never acts in a window the look marks protected or as a system configuration tool (protected_window).
tools.input.visible.controls: Look at an application window: its visible controls (index, kind, name, state), and the text on screen with includeText (or when the window shows no controls); the view says when the text was not read or was cut. It presses and types nothing; a minimized window is shown behind the one in front, not activated, and the view says so. Use when: you must act inside an open app or read what it shows — before clicking, typing or answering about it — or the person asks what is on screen; set application to the app's name (for example right after opening it). Do not use when: the text of a web page is wanted (use browser_page_read). Examples: «entra a Tu biblioteca en Spotify» (look at Spotify, then click «Tu biblioteca»), «¿qué marca la calculadora?», «¿qué botones hay?».
tools.media.control: Pause, play, resume, stop, skip to next or go back to previous on what is already playing. Use when: pausa, siguiente, skip, anterior or dale play without naming new content. Do not use when: playing something new by name (use media_play_query, media_play_exact, media_play_youtube or streaming_play_named), seeking seconds (use media_seek_relative), muting (use audio_mute). Examples: «pausa la música», «siguiente canción», «dale play».
tools.media.play.exact: Play one exact song by its title on Spotify, not just open the app: the result titled as title (case, accents and punctuation aside) is played and the now-playing line must name it; a song already playing is left as it is (alreadyPlaying, nothing pressed); with several songs of that title, the topmost titled so plays: to choose the artist, use media_play_query with title and artist. Use when: a precise song title is given. Do not use when: an artist, genre or loose search (use media_play_query), YouTube or a video (use media_play_youtube), a movie or series (use streaming_play_named), only opening Spotify (use app_open). Examples: «pon la canción Bohemian Rhapsody», «reproduce Despacito exacta en spotify», «play the song Yellow».
tools.media.play.query: Search music on Spotify (song, artist or style) with query exactly as written and play the first result of Spotify's own search (the result titled as query, case, accents and punctuation aside, when Spotify shows one). The receipt says which control was pressed (selectedControl) and what plays (title, observedNowPlaying), not whether it is what was asked for. Use when: pon or play X, where X is any song, artist, podcast or style, even one you do not know or that sounds misheard: pass X as you heard it. Do not use when: one exact song title (use media_play_exact), YouTube named, even for music, or a video (use media_play_youtube), a movie or series (use streaming_play_named), resuming (use media_control), only opening Spotify (use app_open). Examples: «pon música de bad bunny», «ponme algo de rock en spotify», «play some lofi».
tools.media.play.youtube: Search a video on YouTube and play it: where BAXY's own player is installed and finds it, its sound only (audioOnly) in a window titled «BAXY YouTube»; otherwise in the person's browser, or, when that cannot be opened, in BAXY's own browser. In the browser it plays the first video YouTube lists for the search. Use when: a video, or music on YouTube, should play. Do not use when: music on Spotify (use media_play_query or media_play_exact), Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max titles (use streaming_play_named), opening YouTube or searching it without playing (use browser_navigate). Examples: «pon un video de gatos en youtube», «ponme el tráiler de dune en youtube», «play lofi en youtube».
tools.media.seek.relative: Skip forward or back a number of seconds in what is playing. Use when: adelanta or retrocede N segundos. Do not use when: next or previous track (use media_control). Examples: «adelanta 30 segundos», «retrocede 10 segundos», «skip 1 minute».
tools.media.status: Read what is playing now: title, artist and whether it is paused, without changing anything. Use when: qué canción es or qué está sonando. Do not use when: the volume (use audio_status). Examples: «¿qué canción está sonando?», «¿cómo se llama esta canción?», «what's playing?».
tools.memory.correct: Correct a fact BAXY already remembers, replacing its value with a new one. Use when: the person fixes a remembered datum. Do not use when: saving a new fact (use memory_save), forgetting it (use memory_forget). Examples: «corrige: mi color favorito es el verde», «no, mi perro se llama Toby, no Tobi», «actualiza mi equipo favorito a Colo-Colo». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.disable: Turn BAXY's memory off so it stops saving and reading facts. Use when: desactiva la memoria or deja de recordar. Do not use when: forgetting specific data (use memory_forget), clearing only this conversation (use memory_session_clear). Examples: «desactiva tu memoria», «deja de recordar cosas», «turn off memory». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.enable: Turn BAXY's private memory on. Use when: activa la memoria. Do not use when: only asking whether it is on (use memory_status). Examples: «activa tu memoria», «vuelve a recordar cosas», «enable memory». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.export: Prepare a private export of what BAXY remembers into Documents, without secret data. Use when: exporta or saca una copia de la memoria. Do not use when: just listing it (use memory_list). Examples: «exporta lo que recuerdas», «sácame una copia de tu memoria», «export memory».
tools.memory.forget: Make BAXY forget remembered facts (one fact, a topic, a kind or all), after confirming what is deleted. Use when: olvida X or borra lo que sabes de X. Do not use when: only this conversation (use memory_session_clear), turning memory off (use memory_disable), changing a value (use memory_correct). Examples: «olvida mi dirección», «borra todo lo que recuerdas», «forget my birthday». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.list: List what BAXY remembers, 20 at most per view (shown and total say how many there are). Use when: a general question about all remembered facts. Do not use when: one concrete thing (use memory_recall), notes (use note_list). Examples: «¿qué cosas recuerdas?», «lista tu memoria», «what do you remember?».
tools.memory.recall: Ask BAXY what it remembers about one concrete thing (5 at most; shown and total say how many there are). Use when: cuál es mi X or te acuerdas de X. Do not use when: everything remembered (use memory_list), searching notes (use note_search). Examples: «¿cuál es mi color favorito?», «¿cómo me llamo?», «¿te acuerdas de mi cumpleaños?», «¿qué recuerdas de mi perro?».
tools.memory.save: Ask BAXY to remember a fact, preference or rule that is not sensitive. At most 512 memories; when full it fails (memory_capacity_reached). Use when: recuerda que or acuérdate de que. Do not use when: sensitive or secret data (use memory_sensitive_save), it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), a note (use note_create), a to-do (use task_create). Examples: «recuerda que mi color favorito es el azul», «acuérdate de que prefiero respuestas cortas», «remember que mi perro se llama Toby». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.sensitive.save: Ask BAXY to remember a sensitive or secret datum (health, ID numbers, keys). At most 512 memories; when full it fails (memory_capacity_reached). Use when: the fact to remember is sensitive. Do not use when: an ordinary fact or preference (use memory_save). Examples: «recuerda mi RUT 12.345.678-9», «guarda que soy alérgico a la penicilina», «remember mi clave del wifi». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.session.clear: Delete what was remembered for this session only (retention session: since BAXY last started; a new conversation in the panel does not start a new memory session, so it also deletes what was said for the session before it); temporary memories (kept 24 hours) stay until they expire, and permanent memory is kept. Use when: olvida lo de esta conversación. Do not use when: forgetting permanent facts, or everything about the person (use memory_forget). Examples: «olvida lo que hablamos ahora», «borra la memoria de esta sesión», «clear this session». Say in your answer what you turned on or changed in memory.
tools.memory.status: Report whether BAXY's memory is on and what its limits are. Use when: asking if memory is active. Do not use when: listing remembered facts (use memory_list). Examples: «¿está activa tu memoria?», «¿puedes recordar cosas?», «memory status».
tools.message.draft: Leave a message written for someone in WhatsApp or Discord, unsent; the person sends it. Use when: the person wants it left written without sending (déjale escrito, sin enviar). Do not use when: sending it (use message_send), an email (use email_send), a test send (use message_send_test). Examples: «déjale escrito a Lucía por whatsapp que llego a las 8», «escríbele a Pedro en discord que se conecte, pero no lo envíes». The recipient is the contact name as the person says it (a name or a family word); never ask for a phone number. WhatsApp opens only a chat named exactly so (case and accents aside); with none or several, nothing is written and the chat list's names come back as candidates (the first 8; candidateCount says how many). Discord opens the first switcher result holding those words (never a voice channel's row: recipient_not_found with that row as observed) and writes only if that chat's title is exactly the name; otherwise nothing is written, that chat stays open and no candidates come back.
tools.message.send: Send a message to someone in WhatsApp or Discord: their chat is opened, the message written, send pressed and the message read back in the chat; the person is always asked first. Use when: mándale, envíale or dile algo a X por whatsapp or discord. Do not use when: it should only be left written (use message_draft), an email (use email_send), a test send (use message_send_test). Examples: «mándale a Vicho por whatsapp que voy en camino», «dile a Lucía por whatsapp que llego a las 8», «envíale a Pedro en discord que se conecte». The recipient is the contact name as the person says it (a name or a family word); never ask for a phone number. WhatsApp sends only to a chat named exactly so (case and accents aside); with none or several, nothing is sent and the chat list's names come back as candidates (the first 8; candidateCount says how many). Discord sends only if the opened chat's title is exactly the name.
tools.message.send.test: Really send a test message or email, always forced to the owner's test channel, never to the person named. Use when: a mensaje or correo de prueba is asked for. Do not use when: a normal message to a contact (use message_draft), a normal email (use email_send). Examples: «manda un mensaje de prueba por whatsapp», «envía un correo de prueba», «test message en discord».
tools.network.dns.status: Read which DNS servers the PC's connection uses. Use when: qué DNS uso. Do not use when: IP addresses (use network_ip_list), general connectivity (use network_status). Examples: «¿qué dns tengo?», «muéstrame los servidores dns», «dns actuales?».
tools.network.ip.list: List this PC's own IP addresses. Use when: cuál es mi IP. Do not use when: DNS servers (use network_dns_status), testing another host (use network_ping). Examples: «¿cuál es mi ip?», «dime mis direcciones ip», «what's my ip».
tools.network.ping: Ping a host or address once and say whether it answers and how long it takes. Use when: haz ping or responde X. Do not use when: general internet connectivity (use network_status). Examples: «haz ping a google.com», «¿responde 8.8.8.8?», «ping a cloudflare».
tools.network.port.list: List the PC's open listening TCP and UDP ports. 50 by default (truncated, stableCount). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: qué puertos están abiertos. Do not use when: running programs (use system_process_list). Examples: «¿qué puertos tengo abiertos?», «lista los puertos en escucha», «open ports?».
tools.network.status: Check whether there is internet connectivity and which network connections are active: online is Windows' own internet check, and connectivity says internet, constrained (a sign-in portal or limited access), local (a network without internet) or none. Use when: tengo internet. Do not use when: Wi-Fi specifically (use wifi_status), pinging a host (use network_ping). Examples: «¿tengo internet?», «¿estoy conectado a la red?», «network status».
tools.note.create: Create a private note with a title and free-text content. At most 512 notes, those in the trash included; when full it fails (note_capacity_reached). Use when: crea una nota or toma nota. Do not use when: a to-do or list item (use task_create), something that rings or reminds at a time (use schedule_alarms), a fact for BAXY to remember (use memory_save), a text file (use file_write). Examples: «crea una nota que diga comprar pan», «toma nota: ideas para la tesis», «haz una nota reunión con Juan».
tools.note.list: List the notes, active or in the trash. 50 by default, but a view shows 20 at most; nextOffset reads on (totalCount says how many). Use when: qué notas tengo. Do not use when: searching inside notes (use note_search), tasks (use task_list). Examples: «¿qué notas tengo?», «muéstrame las notas borradas», «list my notes».
tools.note.read: Read one note by its title. Use when: lee la nota X. Do not use when: searching notes by text (use note_search). Examples: «lee la nota ideas», «¿qué dice la nota de compras?», «read note tesis».
tools.note.restore: Restore a deleted note from the trash, by its title. Use when: recupera la nota X. Do not use when: a task (use task_restore). Examples: «recupera la nota ideas», «restaura la nota que borré», «undelete note compras».
tools.note.search: Search the notes that contain a text. 20 by default (totalCount). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: busca en mis notas. Do not use when: files (use file_find), tasks (use task_search), the internet (use web_search). Examples: «busca en mis notas la palabra tesis», «¿en qué nota puse el teléfono de Juan?», «search notes for receta».
tools.note.trash: Delete a note by its title, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra la nota X. Do not use when: a task (use task_delete), a file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «borra la nota ideas», «elimina la nota de compras», «delete note tesis».
tools.note.update: Change an existing note: its title and its content are both replaced by what is sent (note_list does not return the content, so read it with note_read and send it again when only the title changes). Use when: cambia or edita la nota X. Do not use when: a new note (use note_create), a task (use task_update). Examples: «cambia la nota ideas a 'llamar al profe'», «edita la nota compras: leche y pan», «renombra la nota tesis a proyecto».
tools.ocr.read: Read the text that appears in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Only the last 16 captures are kept; an older id gives capture_not_found. With much text the words' boxes are left out (layout available false) and the text stays. Use when: the text on screen or in a capture is wanted. Do not use when: describing what is seen (use vision_describe), the open web page (use browser_page_read), no capture yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «lee el texto de la captura», «¿qué dice en la pantalla?», «haz OCR de la captura».
tools.office.document.create: Create a new Office document, Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx), with a title. Use when: crea un documento de Word or una planilla Excel. Do not use when: a PowerPoint (use document_presentation_create), a plain text file (use file_write). Examples: «crea un documento de word llamado informe», «haz una planilla excel de gastos», «new word doc tesis».
tools.office.document.read: Read the content of an already identified Office document. Use when: reading a document created or identified earlier. Do not use when: a PDF or a text file (use file_read). Examples: «lee ese documento», «¿qué dice el word que creaste?», «read that doc».
tools.package.install: Install a normal program on the PC with winget and verify it is installed, after confirmation. packageId is the winget id (Spotify.Spotify) or the program's name as the person said it (spotify, vlc). A name that is not exactly one package installs nothing and lists the candidates winget gave (name, packageId, packageSource; candidateCount says how many, truncated past the eight listed): call again with the packageId the person wants, or ask which. alreadyInstalled true: it was there and nothing ran. winget_install_still_running: the installer started and has not finished: say it is installing, not that it is installed. Use when: instala, descarga e instala or pon a program. Do not use when: uninstalling (use package_uninstall), a Steam or Epic game (use game_install_named), opening it (use app_open). Examples: «instala spotify», «bájame el vlc», «install 7-zip».
tools.package.uninstall: Uninstall a normal program from the PC by its name and verify it is gone, after confirmation. At most 8 candidates come back (candidateCount, truncated); after 12 seconds the result says winget_uninstall_still_running (it goes on uninstalling). Use when: desinstala a program. Do not use when: installing (use package_install), a Steam game (use game_uninstall_named), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «desinstala discord», «quita el zoom del pc», «uninstall vlc».
tools.peripheral.list: List peripherals, optionally of one kind: mice, keyboards and USB devices present now, scanners available, and printers installed (their queues, virtual ones such as PDF included, with Windows' status). A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Mice and keyboards come before the USB devices. Use when: qué periféricos hay or is a mouse connected or a printer installed. Do not use when: USB drives and free space (use storage_removable_list), Bluetooth devices (use bluetooth_device_list), monitors (use display_status). Examples: «¿qué periféricos hay conectados?», «¿hay una impresora conectada?», «lista los dispositivos usb».
tools.peripheral.print: Print an already identified document on a printer. Use when: imprime. Do not use when: listing printers (use peripheral_list). Examples: «imprime ese documento», «mándalo a la impresora», «print it».
tools.peripheral.scan: Scan a document with a scanner. Use when: escanea. Do not use when: a screenshot (use capture_screenshot), reading text from a capture (use ocr_read). Examples: «escanea este documento», «usa el escáner», «scan a page».
tools.schedule.alarms: Set, list or cancel BAXY's alarms and reminders, which ring on this PC (Windows Task Scheduler; also on battery, and from sleep only where the power plan allows wake timers; not when it is shut down), or check why one did not ring. Use when: an alarm, a timer, a wake-up or a reminder at a time or in some minutes, which ones are set, or cancelling one. Do not use when: a to-do without a time (use task_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create), a note (use note_create). How to fill it: action create needs title and either inMinutes (minutes from now), inSeconds (seconds, for a short timer) or at (the local time in 24 hours, HH:mm, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for another day); kind alarm for alarms and wake-ups, reminder otherwise; recurrence daily or hourly only when it repeats. action cancel takes the kind of the one meant (alarm for an alarm, reminder by default): with at (HH:mm only) it cancels the one of that kind at that local time, without at the only one pending (with several it cancels none and lists them, and at names the one); list shows the next ones by time, each with its kind (a view shows the next 20 at most; count says how many are set). Examples: «recuérdame en 20 minutos sacar la ropa» (create, inMinutes 20), «despiértame mañana a las 7» (create, alarm, at 07:00), «qué alarmas tengo» (list), «cancela la alarma de las 7» (cancel, alarm, at 07:00).
tools.shell.command.run: Run a PowerShell console command and return its output; cwd is desktop, documents, downloads or home, optionally with a folder inside it (documents/proyecto), or a full path; without cwd it runs in a private empty folder; a command that does more than read (writes, deletes, installs, sends, runs a program) waits for the person's yes. It is stopped after 60 seconds (shell_command_timeout); only the first 8,192 characters of output come back (truncated true), so a summary printed at the end may be cut; output past about one million characters stops the command and nothing of it comes back (shell_command_output_too_large). Use when: ejecuta or corre a command. Do not use when: a dedicated operation exists (system_process_list, network_ping, app_open). Examples: «ejecuta ls en el escritorio», «corre pytest en documentos/proyecto», «run git status».
tools.software.python.package.status: Check whether a Python package is installed, and its version, in each Python registered in Windows (PEP 514), by asking its pip, without installing anything; a pip that did not answer leaves that Python unread. Use when: tengo X instalado for a Python package. Do not use when: which Python versions exist (use software_python_status), normal apps (use app_installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado numpy?», «¿qué versión de pandas tengo?», «is requests installed?».
tools.software.python.status: List the Python versions registered in Windows (the PEP 514 registry keys the python.org and Store installers write); a Python outside that registry (pyenv, portable, conda without registration) is not seen. Use when: qué python tengo. Do not use when: a Python package (use software_python_package_status). Examples: «¿qué versión de python tengo?», «¿está instalado python?», «python versions?».
tools.storage.removable.list: List the removable drives connected now (pendrives, SD cards) and their free space; an external USB disk Windows sees as fixed is not listed. Use when: hay un pendrive or cuánto espacio le queda al USB. Do not use when: the internal disk (use system_status), other peripherals (use peripheral_list). Examples: «¿hay un pendrive conectado?», «¿cuánto espacio le queda al usb?».
tools.streaming.navigate: Go to an exact content address on a streaming service (Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, YouTube), without searching by title. Use when: a specific streaming link or id is already known. Do not use when: a title is named (use streaming_play_named), a YouTube search (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «abre este link de netflix: netflix.com/watch/123», «ve a esa dirección de hbo max», «open this prime video link».
tools.streaming.play.named: Play a movie or series by its title on Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max and verify it plays: in BAXY's own browser by the video advancing, in the person's browser by the system's media session saying playing. Only the search result named as title (case and accents aside) is opened: write the title as the service names it; when none is, nothing plays and the search page's links and buttons (menus included; in the person's browser only those holding the title when any do, and the first 10) come back as candidates. A «who is watching» profile screen stops it: the person picks the profile. Use when: a film or series title is named. Do not use when: music (use media_play_query or media_play_exact), YouTube videos (use media_play_youtube), only opening the Netflix app (use app_open). Examples: «pon stranger things en netflix», «quiero ver Moana en disney plus», «play The Last of Us en hbo max».
tools.system.application.crash.diagnose: Report recent Windows Error Reporting events: application crashes and hangs, and other reports Windows files the same way (an update failure, a kernel event), each under its report's name. It looks at the last 24 hours, 20 events by default; its counts stop at four times limit (80 by default, 200 at most), so they are no total. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: why did an app close by itself or which apps froze. Do not use when: running processes (use system_process_list), alarms not ringing (use schedule_alarms). Examples: «¿qué aplicaciones se cayeron hoy?», «¿por qué se cerró el chrome?», «any app crashes recently?».
tools.system.identity: Read which Windows user account BAXY runs under; it does not tell the person's name. Use when: con qué usuario de Windows. Do not use when: the person's own name (use memory_recall). Examples: «¿con qué cuenta de windows corres?», «¿qué usuario de windows es este?», «whoami».
tools.system.power: Lock, sign out, sleep, shut down or restart the PC. Use when: apaga, reinicia, bloquea or suspende el PC. Do not use when: closing apps (use app_close or window_close_all), restarting one (app_restart), radios (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «apaga el pc», «reinicia el computador», «bloquea la pantalla». Never use it to silence, mute or lower sound: that is audio_mute. Turning the PC off is only for apaga/shut down.
tools.system.process.list: List running processes, sorted by CPU, memory or name. 10 by default (observedProcessCount is the total). Use when: qué procesos corren or qué consume más. Do not use when: whether one app has an open window (use window_application_status), overall CPU or RAM (use system_status). Examples: «¿qué procesos usan más memoria?», «lista los programas corriendo», «top cpu processes».
tools.system.process.terminate.named: Force-kill a program by its executable name, with confirmation; this is not a normal window close. Use when: mata, fuerza el cierre or the program no responde. Do not use when: a normal close of an app (use app_close), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «fuerza el cierre de chrome.exe», «mata el proceso de spotify», «kill discord que se pegó».
tools.system.recyclebin.empty: Empty the Windows Recycle Bin. Use when: vacía la papelera. Do not use when: deleting one file (use filesystem_known_trash_named). Examples: «vacía la papelera», «limpia la papelera de reciclaje», «empty recycle bin».
tools.system.settings.adjust: Raise or lower screen brightness by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube or baja el brillo with an amount. Do not use when: a target brightness level is given (use system_settings_set), volume (use audio_volume_adjust). Examples: «sube el brillo 20», «bájale 10 al brillo», «brightness down 15».
tools.system.settings.set: Set brightness to a level, or turn do-not-disturb, airplane mode (every Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile radio off or on, through the radio API) or BAXY's accessible mode on or off; can also turn BAXY's confirmation bypass off. Do-not-disturb goes through Windows Settings: its Notifications page opens, takes the front and is left open (settingsWindowOpened), also when the setting already was so or on a failure. Use when: brillo al N, no molestar, modo avión. Do not use when: brightness by an amount (use system_settings_adjust), Wi-Fi or Bluetooth alone (use wifi_radio_set or bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «pon el brillo al 70», «activa el modo avión», «activa no molestar».
tools.system.settings.status: Read the current screen brightness, or for airplane mode whether every Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile radio is off (allRadiosOff; Windows' own airplane switch is not read), without changing it. Use when: en cuánto está el brillo. Do not use when: changing it (use system_settings_set or system_settings_adjust). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el brillo?», «¿qué brillo tiene la pantalla?», «¿está activado el modo avión?».
tools.system.status: Read PC status: CPU, memory, the system drive (C:, not other drives), battery, graphics card and Windows; scope firewall: its profiles and which are on; scope updates: a pending restart and the updates waiting at Windows' last search (from its cache, no new search; first 10 titles). Use when: battery, RAM, disk, specs, firewall or Windows updates questions. Do not use when: per-process usage (use system_process_list), monitors (use display_status), USB drives (use storage_removable_list). Examples: «¿cuánta batería tengo?», «¿cuánta ram estoy usando?», «¿qué tarjeta gráfica tengo?».
tools.system.time: Read the current date and time, here or in another place or time zone. Use when: qué hora es or qué día es. Do not use when: weather, «qué tiempo hace» included (use weather_current), setting an alarm (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list).
