Examples: «¿qué hora es?», «¿qué hora es en Tokio?», «¿qué fecha es hoy?». Always use it for the time or date in another city or country; never state another place's time from memory.
tools.task.complete: Mark a to-do as done or cross an item off a list. Use when: ya lo hice or tacha X. Do not use when: deleting it (use task_delete). Examples: «marca como hecha la tarea pagar la luz», «tacha el pan de la lista del súper», «done con la tarea informe».
tools.task.create: Create a to-do; tasks have no separate lists (task_list shows them all together), and its optional date schedules no notification. Use when: anota de pendiente or agrega una tarea. Do not use when: it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule_alarms), free-text notes (use note_create), a calendar event (use calendar_event_create). Examples: «anota comprar leche», «anota de pendiente llamar al banco», «add task terminar el informe».
tools.task.delete: Delete a task or remove an item from a list, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra or quita X de la lista. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_trash). Examples: «quita el pan de la lista», «borra la tarea informe», «delete task banco».
tools.task.list: List tasks, all in one list (there are no separate lists): open, done or deleted. 20 by default (totalCount); without status only open tasks are listed. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: qué tengo pendiente. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule_alarms), the calendar (use calendar_event_list), notes (use note_list). Examples: «¿qué tengo pendiente?», «léeme mis tareas», «show completed tasks».
tools.task.reopen: Reopen a task that had been marked as done. Use when: desmarca or it was not done after all. Do not use when: restoring a deleted task (use task_restore). Examples: «reabre la tarea informe», «desmarca el pan, no lo compré», «reopen task banco».
tools.task.restore: Restore a deleted task. Use when: recupera la tarea que borré. Do not use when: reopening a completed task (use task_reopen). Examples: «recupera la tarea que borré», «restaura llamar al banco», «undelete task informe».
tools.task.search: Search the tasks whose title or details contain a text. 20 by default (totalCount); deleted tasks are not searched. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: busca en mis tareas. Do not use when: notes (use note_search), files (use file_find). Examples: «busca tareas sobre la tesis», «¿tengo alguna tarea con banco?», «search tasks informe».
tools.task.update: Change a task: title, details and date are all replaced by what is sent (task_list does not return the details, so changing only the date clears them unless they are sent again). Use when: cambia la fecha or el nombre de la tarea X. Do not use when: marking it done (use task_complete), a note (use note_update). Examples: «cambia la tarea informe para el lunes», «renombra la tarea banco a ir al banco», «update task pan: dos marraquetas».
tools.vision.describe: Describe what is seen in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id), only with a local vision model configured on this PC: without one it fails with vision_provider_not_configured, so say you cannot see images. Only the last 16 captures are kept; an older id gives capture_not_found. Use when: qué ves en la pantalla or describe la captura. Do not use when: only the text (use ocr_read), the clickable controls (use input_visible_controls), no capture exists yet (use capture_screenshot first). Examples: «¿qué ves en la captura?», «describe lo que hay en pantalla», «what's on my screen?».
tools.weather.current: Read the current weather and tomorrow's forecast, here or in a named place. Without location, «here» is this PC's city as a public service places it by its internet address (approximate; locatedBy says so); the person did not say where they are. location is the place's own name, optionally with a comma and its region or country («Valencia, España», «Foster City, California»); only a place named exactly so is read. With several places of comparable size of that name, or none, nothing is read and they come back as candidates (name, region, country; the first 8, candidateCount says how many): ask which one, or call again with the region or country. Use when: clima, qué tiempo hace, temperatura, va a llover, or whether to take an umbrella or a jacket. Do not use when: news (use web_search with source news), the time (use system_time). Examples: «¿cómo está el clima?», «¿va a llover mañana en Santiago?», «weather en Valparaíso».
tools.web.download: Download a file or image from the internet into a known folder (Downloads by default), by its public web address (url; never this PC or the local network); the address of a web page downloads the image that page announces as its cover. Files over 50 MiB are not downloaded (download_too_large). Without an address, find one first with web_search and download a result's url. At most 3 redirects. It gives up when the server takes over 40 seconds to answer (each redirect included); the whole download must end within about 100 seconds (what BAXY waits for one operation), or BAXY reports it failed (one ending just after may still be written). Use when: descarga or bájame a file or image. Do not use when: a game (use game_install_named), just viewing a page (use browser_navigate). Examples: «descarga la imagen de portada de wikipedia.org al escritorio», «bájame un meme», «download ejemplo.com/manual.pdf».
tools.web.fetch: Read one public web page (http or https) as plain text: title, final address and text (navigation, header, footer, asides, buttons and selects left out; a page that is not HTML is refused, web_fetch_not_html). A long page comes in pages: when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset; bodyTruncated true: the page was longer than BAXY reads (1.5 MB, 1,500,000 bytes) and its text stops there. Never call again with the same url and offset: the same text comes back. At most 3 redirects (web_fetch_too_many_redirects). Use when: the person gives a link or asks what a page says, or to read a page a web_search result points to. Do not use when: looking something up (use web_search), showing the page to the person (use browser_navigate), saving a file (use web_download). Examples: «léeme esta página https://…», «¿qué dice el primer resultado?», «read https://example.com/news».
tools.web.search: Look something up in one public source and return what it returned, as given. «source»: «web» (default): a web search engine; each result has title, url and snippet. «news»: a Google News search for the query; for the news in general, search «noticias» (or the person's words) with source news, as there is no separate list of headlines; each item has title, outlet, url and time. «encyclopedia»: Wikipedia in «language» (es or en, default es); each article has title, url and its opening lines. «currency»: «from» and «to» are ISO 4217 codes (USD, EUR, CLP, MXN, ARS…), «amount» the number to convert (default 1); returns the rate, its date and the converted amount. «sports»: a team's match, only NBA and the football leagues the sports calendar covers (no other sport, no women's leagues: no result); «team» as a sports site writes it (Boca Juniors, Los Angeles Lakers, national sides in English: Spain, Chile), «wants» next (default) or last; returns that match as the calendar gives it, with the team it found. «places»: sites of a kind in a place; «kind» in English (pharmacy, parking, restaurant, atm), «place» with its city and country (Plaza de Armas, Santiago, Chile); returns names, addresses and distances. «query» always says what you look for; for web, news and encyclopedia it is the text searched: write search words and years as numbers (2026, not this year). «limit»: 1 to 10 results (default 5). «nearby»: true adds this PC's city and country to the query (for places, they are the place, after «place» if given); use it only when the person asks for something near them. Results are not checked against the question: judge them yourself, and to read a result's page call web_fetch with its url. Use when: what changes over time or what you are not sure of: news, prices, schedules, results, currency conversions, a team's next or last match, places near me or in a named place. Do not use when: what you know for sure and does not change (definitions, geography, science, well-known history): answer it yourself; weather (use weather_current), opening a site or results page in the browser (use browser_navigate), playing YouTube (use media_play_youtube). Examples: «¿qué pasó hoy en el congreso?» → source news, query «congreso»; «¿cuánto son 100 dólares en pesos chilenos?» → source currency, from USD, to CLP, amount 100; «¿cuándo juega Boca?» → source sports, team «Boca Juniors», wants next; «farmacias cerca de mí» → source places, kind «pharmacy», nearby true; «busca opiniones del iPhone 17» → source web. It only reads: never use it to buy, order, book, pay or act for the person; if no tool does that action, say in one sentence you don't.
tools.wifi.connect: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network already identified by its profile id. Use when: the network was identified earlier in the conversation. Do not use when: the network is said by name or by place such as casa or trabajo (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «conéctate a esa red», «sí, conéctate», «connect to it».
tools.wifi.connect.named: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network by its name, or by its place (casa, trabajo, oficina) once a call that named both the network and the place has taught it; a place not taught yet comes back wifi_place_unknown. Use when: conéctate al wifi X or al de la casa. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio on (use wifi_radio_set), seeing networks around (use wifi_scan). Examples: «conéctate al wifi de la casa», «conéctate a la red MiCasa5G», «connect al wifi del trabajo».
tools.wifi.disconnect: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network. Use when: desconéctate del wifi. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio off (use wifi_radio_set). Examples: «desconéctate del wifi», «sal de esta red», «disconnect wifi».
tools.wifi.ensure.connected: Check that Wi-Fi is already connected, without changing anything. Use when: a step must make sure Wi-Fi is connected. Do not use when: the person simply asks whether they are connected (use wifi_status), connecting (use wifi_connect_named). Examples: «asegúrate de que el wifi esté conectado», «comprueba que sigo en el wifi», «make sure wifi is connected».
tools.wifi.profile.list: List the Wi-Fi networks saved on the PC. A view shows 20 at most (truncated, …Shown; the rest is not reached). Use when: qué redes tengo guardadas. Do not use when: networks around now (use wifi_scan). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi tengo guardadas?», «lista mis redes guardadas», «saved wifi networks».
tools.wifi.radio.set: Turn the PC's Wi-Fi on or off. Use when: prende or apaga el wifi. Do not use when: leaving one network only (use wifi_disconnect), airplane mode (use system_settings_set), Bluetooth (use bluetooth_radio_set). Examples: «apaga el wifi», «prende el wifi», «turn wifi on».
tools.wifi.radio.status: Read whether Wi-Fi is on or off, without changing it. Use when: está prendido el wifi. Do not use when: whether it is connected to a network (use wifi_status). Examples: «¿está prendido el wifi?», «¿tengo el wifi activado?», «wifi on or off?».
tools.wifi.scan: List the Wi-Fi networks available around now, with their signal. At most 50 networks are read (listedCount when cut; networkCount is how many Windows saw), and a view shows 20 of them (truncated says so). Use when: qué redes hay disponibles. Do not use when: saved networks (use wifi_profile_list). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi hay disponibles?», «busca redes wifi», «scan wifi».
tools.wifi.status: Check whether the PC is connected to a Wi-Fi network right now. Use when: estoy conectado al wifi. Do not use when: general internet (use network_status), radio on or off (use wifi_radio_status). Examples: «¿estoy conectado al wifi?», «¿tengo wifi?», «wifi status».
tools.window.active: Tell which window or application is in the foreground now. Use when: qué ventana está activa or al frente. Do not use when: whether a named app is open (use window_application_status). Examples: «¿qué ventana tengo activa?», «¿qué programa está al frente?», «what window is this?».
tools.window.application.status: Check whether a named application is open with a visible window, without opening it. Only applications of the Start catalog are checked: for any other the result says inStartCatalog false and nothing about its windows. Use when: está abierto X. Do not use when: opening it (use app_open), whether it is installed (use app_installed), which window is in front (use window_active). Examples: «¿está abierto el spotify?», «¿tengo el chrome abierto?», «is discord open?».
tools.window.close.all: Close every open window of this desktop (editors and terminals too) but BAXY's own, after the person's yes; never forces: a window that asks to save stays open; windows on another virtual desktop are not touched (cloakedWindows counts them); a desktop window that could not be read is counted in unreadWindows. Use when: cierra todo or todas las ventanas. Do not use when: one app or one window, the active one included (use app_close), only hiding windows to see the desktop (use window_minimize_all). Examples: «cierra todas las ventanas», «cierra todo», «close everything».
tools.window.focus: Bring an open window to the front by the windowId that window_resolve, window_active or app_open returned, or the one the last window action gave back (never windowHandle or another number). A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: cambia a, ve a or trae al frente an open app. Do not use when: the app is not open (use app_open), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «tráeme al frente el chrome», «cambia a la ventana de word», «focus spotify».
tools.window.maximize: Maximize an already identified window. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: maximiza or agranda la ventana. Do not use when: back to normal size (use window_restore), fullscreen video in the browser (use browser_control). Examples: «maximiza el chrome», «agranda la ventana», «maximize word». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.minimize: Minimize one already identified window, not all. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: minimiza X or esta ventana. Do not use when: minimizing everything to show the desktop (use window_minimize_all), closing it (use app_close). Examples: «minimiza el spotify», «minimiza esta ventana», «minimize chrome». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.minimize.all: Minimize all windows of this desktop except BAXY's own to show the desktop (allMinimized says whether none of the others is left), closing nothing; windows on another virtual desktop are not touched (cloakedWindows counts them); a desktop window that could not be read is counted in unreadWindows. Use when: minimiza todo or muéstrame el escritorio. Do not use when: one window or one named application (use window_minimize), closing all windows (use window_close_all). Examples: «minimiza todo», «muéstrame el escritorio», «minimize all».
tools.window.move: Move an already identified window to another position on the screen (x, y). Use when: mueve la ventana a a position. Do not use when: the left or right half (use window_snap), changing its size (use window_resize). Examples: «mueve el chrome arriba a la izquierda», «mueve la ventana a 100, 100», «move notepad a la esquina». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.resize: Resize an already identified window to a given width and height. Use when: cambia el tamaño a N por M. Do not use when: maximizing (use window_maximize), half the screen (use window_snap). Examples: «haz la ventana de 800 por 600», «cambia el tamaño del bloc de notas a 1024x768», «resize chrome to 1280x720». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.resolve: List the open windows of an application or process, each with its windowId, title, state and whether it is in front. Use when: you need the windowId of an open app's window to focus, maximize, minimize, restore, snap, move or resize it. Do not use when: only whether the app is open (use window_application_status), the window in front (use window_active). Examples: «maximiza el chrome» (resolve chrome, then window_maximize), «pon el bloc de notas a la izquierda», «minimiza spotify».
tools.window.restore: Return an already identified minimized or maximized window to its normal size. Use when: restaura or devuelve la ventana a su tamaño. Do not use when: only bringing it to front (use window_focus), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «restaura la ventana del chrome», «vuelve el spotify a tamaño normal», «restore word». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.window.snap: Place an already identified window on the left or right half of the screen. A windowId expires after 5 minutes (invalid_or_expired_window_id). Use when: pon X a la izquierda or a la derecha. Do not use when: exact coordinates (use window_move), maximizing (use window_maximize). Examples: «pon el chrome a la izquierda», «manda el word a la mitad derecha», «snap spotify right». Its windowId comes from window_resolve, window_active or app_open (never windowHandle); each window action returns a fresh windowId for the next one.
tools.office.format.apply: Give a format (bold, italic, underline, or align left, center or right) to what the person has open in Word or Excel, through the open application itself, and read it back; it opens nothing. In Word it formats the selected text, the document's title (target title) or a paragraph by its number (target paragraph with paragraph); in Excel the selection, a whole row (target row with row), a whole column (target column with column) or cells (target cells with an address like A1:C3), which it leaves selected. Use when: the person asks for a format in Word or Excel (negrita, cursiva, subrayado, centrar, alinear). Do not use when: writing text (use input_text_type), another application (look at its window and click its button). Examples: «pon en negrita lo seleccionado en word», «en excel pon la fila 1 en negrita», «subraya la columna B en excel», «centra el título en word».

file.write.relativePath: The path inside folder (the known folder itself, Documents or Desktop, goes in folder), with every subfolder the person named: «Proyectos/notas.txt». The full path they said (C:\Users\ana\Proyectos\notas.txt) also works.
file.write.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in relativePath).
file.write.append: true adds the text as a new last line («añade al final») and keeps the file.
file.write.expectedSha256: Only to replace a file that exists: the fileSha256 file_read gave for it. version_conflict means the file exists, or the fileSha256 given is not that of the file there now: read it first, or use append.
file.write.text: At most 1 MiB (UTF-8); a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is written.

filesystem.create.directory.relativePath: The path inside folder (the known folder itself, Documents or Desktop, goes in folder), with every subfolder the person named: «Proyectos/notas.txt». The full path they said (C:\Users\ana\Proyectos\notas.txt) also works.

file.read.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.read.offset: Where to go on reading the same file: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the file starts again from the beginning.
file.read.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory); all_known only when they named no folder.

file.find.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.find.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory); all_known only when they named no folder.

file.edit.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
file.edit.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory); all_known only when they named no folder.
file.edit.newText: At most 65,536 bytes (UTF-8); a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and the file is left as it was.

filesystem.known.trash.named.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.
filesystem.known.trash.named.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents or downloads when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs (its name goes in subdirectory); all_known only when they named no folder.

filesystem.folder.open.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.

filesystem.explorer.count.subdirectory: The subfolder of folder the person named, with its parents: «Proyectos» or «Proyectos/2024»; or the full path they said. Leave it out only when they named no subfolder.

media.control.sourceApp: Only to control a player other than what is playing now: its sourceAppUserModelId exactly as a media_status result gave it (media_status names only the session it reports). Leave it out to control what is playing.

input.key.press.target: Where the keyboard is: message_composer when the focused field holds a message to someone, so Enter or Space sends it (BAXY then asks the person first); text_field when it is any other text field, so Delete only erases characters (without it, Delete deletes what is selected and BAXY asks first). Leave it out otherwise.
input.key.press.onto: The exact label, as your last look showed it, of the control Enter or Space presses (the focused button, or the result chosen in a list). A control that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first. Leave it out when the key presses no control.
input.key.press.consequence: overwrite when the key confirms replacing a file that already exists (Enter on the focused «Sí» of «¿Desea reemplazarlo?»): BAXY asks the person first. Leave it out otherwise.

input.visible.click.consequence: overwrite when the click confirms replacing a file that already exists (the «Sí» of «¿Desea reemplazarlo?»): BAXY asks the person first. Leave it out otherwise.
input.visible.click.search: Text to type into the search box the click opens, in the same step; then the result named exactly as that text (or as choose) is pressed. If none is, nothing is pressed and the names seen are returned.
input.visible.click.choose: With search: the exact name of the result to press among those the search shows. Judged like a label: one that sends, joins a call, buys or deletes makes BAXY ask the person first.
input.visible.click.manner: How to press it: double (double click), menu (open its context menu), open (only open its drop-down or split arrow). Leave it out for a normal click.
input.visible.click.controlId: The controlIdentity a click result gave for that control. A look gives no id: for a control of your last look pass its index, not here.

memory.recall.selector: With scope exact: the name the memory was saved under (as memory_list shows it). Case, accents and repeated or edge spaces do not matter; a part of the name, or the name with its inner spaces removed, does not match: with no exact match, what is remembered comes back instead (the first 20 and the total), to tell which one answers.

input.visible.controls.wanted: Words of what you look for in that window (a name, a button). The view keeps sixty controls; with these words, up to ten more whose names have one of them as a whole word are added after those. Leave it out for the usual view.
input.visible.controls.tail: true to keep the last entries of a long window (a conversation's newest messages) when the view is cut, instead of the first ones.
input.visible.controls.includeText: true to also read the text written on screen (what controls do not name: a notice, a message, a number drawn on the window).

web.fetch.offset: Where to go on reading the same page: the nextOffset its last result gave (hasMore true). Without it the page starts again from the beginning.

audio.volume.level: The level the person wants the volume at, 0 to 100: the number after «a», «al», «en» or «hasta», also with sube or baja.

audio.volume.adjust.amount: How much to change it from where it is now: only when the person gave no level to end at («sube 10», «baja 5»).

app.open.place: A section to open directly, only for an app that declares it: {app_places}.

wifi.connect.named.place: casa, oficina or trabajo whenever the person said one.
wifi.connect.named.profileName: The network's name; when only a place was said, repeat that word.

note.read.title: The note's title as the person said it.

note.trash.expectedTitle: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.
note.trash.expectedRevision: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.
note.trash.expectedIsTrashed: Only with noteId, as the call of the last note_trash result gives it.

file.open.folder: Which of the person's folders: desktop, documents, downloads or pictures when they name one; home for any other folder of theirs, with that folder before the file in name («Proyectos\informe.docx»).

weather.current.dialectCountry: The country the person's own way of speaking marks (AR, CL, CO, ES, MX or VE), only when it is clear; leave it out otherwise. It only chooses among places of the same name and comparable size (Valencia in Spain or in Venezuela); the result then says namesakesElsewhere: true, so name the country read. A place, region or country the person said goes in location instead.

input.text.type.text: At most 4,096 characters and 8,192 bytes (UTF-8), with no line break or tab (each is a key of its own: input_key_press); a longer text or one with them is refused and nothing is typed.

email.send.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer body is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

email.latest.reply.expectedMessageId: The messageId email_latest_read gave for the email being answered. The reply goes only to that email: if a newer one arrived, nothing is sent and the result names the newest. Without it the reply may first be refused with the newest email's messageId to pass here.
email.latest.reply.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer reply is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

message.draft.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is written.

message.send.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

message.send.test.text: At most 16,384 bytes (UTF-8); a longer message is refused (invalid arguments) and nothing is sent.

clipboard.write.text.text: At most 65,536 characters; a longer text is refused (invalid arguments) and the clipboard is left as it was.

memory.save.retention: persistent (without expiryPolicy), session (with expiryPolicy session_end: forgotten when the session ends) or temporary (with expiryPolicy after_relevance_window: forgotten after 24 hours); any other pairing is refused and nothing is saved.

memory.sensitive.save.retention: persistent (without expiryPolicy), session (with expiryPolicy session_end: forgotten when the session ends) or temporary (with expiryPolicy after_relevance_window: forgotten after 24 hours); any other pairing is refused and nothing is saved.

office.format.apply.app: word or excel: the application the person has open.
office.format.apply.cells: With target cells: the cells' address (A1:C3).
office.format.apply.column: With target column: the column's letter (columna A is A).
office.format.apply.on: false to remove that format (quitar la negrita); leave it out to apply it.
office.format.apply.paragraph: With target paragraph: the paragraph's number, counted from the top (1 is the first).
office.format.apply.row: With target row: the row's number (fila 1 is 1).
office.format.apply.style: bold, italic, underline, center, left or right.
office.format.apply.target: Leave it out for what is selected. Word: title or paragraph. Excel: row, column or cells.
